limitations: Arithmetic and stated teaching boundaries only; independent author review remains separate. No capacity, permit, operating limit or safety approval is established.

calculations.label: travel and rings
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m.

calculations.label: contact MPa
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value.

calculations.label: friction MN and ratio
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor.

calculations.label: shoe MN and MPa
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked.

calculations.label: parallel minutes and saving percent
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%.

calculations.label: shield friction MN
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設D=6 m、接觸L=4 m、p=0.2 MPa、μ=0.3，F=μpπDL=4.52 MN；L變為6 m時F=6.79 MN，均為理想均壓摩擦。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN.

calculations.label: angle rad and degrees
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設左右量測基距B=5 m、行程差Δ=10 mm=0.010 m，小角θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°；並非允許導向角。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume lateral baseline B=5 m and differential travel Δ=10 mm=0.010 m. The small angle is θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°, not an allowable steering angle.

calculations.label: specific energy kWh/m3 and MJ/m3
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設平均機械功率800 kW、有效切削0.5 h、開挖40 m³，E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³，未扣除各項損失。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mean mechanical power 800 kW, cutting duration 0.5 h and excavation 40 m³. E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³, before separating individual losses.

calculations.label: advance m/day
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設貫入5 mm/rev、2 rev/min、排程20 h/day、利用率0.5，進尺=5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day；利用率0.4時為4.8 m/day。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume penetration 5 mm/rev, 2 rev/min, schedule 20 h/day and utilization 0.5. Advance is 5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day; utilization 0.4 gives 4.8 m/day.

calculations.label: verified percent and unresolved
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設交接要求120個關鍵事件記錄，已驗證114個，完整率114/120=95%；仍有6個未閉合事件，不能以平均完整率取代逐項追查。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume handover requires 120 critical event records and 114 are verified. Completeness is 114/120=95%, leaving six unresolved events; the average percentage cannot replace investigation of each missing item.

calculations.label: block weight kN
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface.

calculations.label: exposure hours
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設支護落後距離6 m、平均有效前進0.8 m/h，時間窗6/0.8=7.5 h；速度降為0.4 m/h時為15 h，非允許自立時間。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume support lags 6 m and effective advance averages 0.8 m/h. Exposure time is 6/0.8=7.5 h; at 0.4 m/h it becomes 15 h. These are not allowable stand-up times.

calculations.label: bolt projected kN
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設四支錨栓各提供60 kN軸向力，與所需方向夾角30°，合分量4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN；不代表設計容許抗力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four bolts each develop 60 kN axially at 30° to the required direction. Their combined component is 4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN, not a design allowable resistance.

calculations.label: elastic strip MPa
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設寬b=1 m、厚t=0.12 m、彎矩M=2 kN·m，彈性應力6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa；t降至0.10 m時為1.2 MPa。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume width b=1 m, thickness t=0.12 m and moment M=2 kN·m. Elastic stress 6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa; reducing t to 0.10 m gives 1.2 MPa.

calculations.label: simple-beam mm and ratio
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設均布q=20 kN/m、EI=50000 kN·m²，L=3 m時δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm；L=4 m時為1.333 mm，為原值3.16倍。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform q=20 kN/m and EI=50000 kN·m². At L=3 m, δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm; at L=4 m it is 1.333 mm, a factor of 3.16.

calculations.label: rate mm/hour and difference std mm
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一測線收斂由8 mm增至11 mm、間隔6 h，平均速率(11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h；若讀值獨立標準差各0.3 mm，差值標準差為0.424 mm。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume convergence rises from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h: mean rate is (11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h. With independent reading standard deviations of 0.3 mm, difference uncertainty is 0.424 mm.

calculations.label: in-situ overbreak m3
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義D=6 m、實測等效D=6.1 m、段長L=2 m，超挖V=π(6.1²-6²)×2/4=1.901 m³；這是原位體積而非鬆方。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal D=6 m, equivalent measured D=6.1 m and length L=2 m. Overbreak is V=π(6.1²-6²)×2/4=1.901 m³ of in-situ ground, not loose muck.

calculations.label: stored m3 and fill hours
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同基準鬆方產生率80 m³/h、移除率65 m³/h，持續2 h增加(80-65)×2=30 m³；若可用暫存20 m³，理想填滿時間20/15=1.33 h。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume loose-volume generation 80 m³/h and removal 65 m³/h on the same basis. Two hours add 30 m³; a 20 m³ free buffer fills ideally in 20/15=1.33 h.

calculations.label: mixing seconds
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設有效體積V=600 m³、潔淨風量Q=20 m³/s，時間常數τ=V/Q=30 s；無持續污染源時90%衰減需ln(10)τ=69.1 s。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume effective volume V=600 m³ and clean airflow Q=20 m³/s. Time constant τ=V/Q=30 s; with no continuing source, 90% decay requires ln(10)τ=69.1 s.

calculations.label: sampling percent
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設100個支護記錄中抽驗20個，覆蓋率20%；若10個異常區記錄僅抽1個，異常區覆蓋率為10%，不能由總體20%推定同等覆蓋。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 20 of 100 support records are checked: coverage is 20%. If only one of ten anomalous-zone records is checked, that zone has 10% coverage, not the overall 20%.

calculations.label: curve intersection mm and MPa
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only.

calculations.label: largest fraction percent and volume m3
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³.

calculations.label: compression MPa and nominal ratio
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設軸力N=300 kN/m、厚t=0.20 m，單位寬平均應力N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa；若合成試驗強度2 MPa，比值為0.75，未含分項係數。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume axial force N=300 kN/m and thickness t=0.20 m. Unit-width mean stress N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa. Against synthetic test strength 2 MPa, the ratio is 0.75 before any partial factors.

calculations.label: edge MPa
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設每米寬N=200 kN、M=10 kN·m、t=0.25 m，σ=N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa，兩緣為1.76與-0.16 MPa，負值表示拉應力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension.

calculations.label: increment mm
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions.

calculations.label: strain microstrain
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設單位寬A=0.25 m²、N=300 kN，E=6 GPa時ε=N/(EA)=200微應變；E=12 GPa時為100微應變，未包含徐變與收縮。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unit-width area A=0.25 m² and N=300 kN. At E=6 GPa, ε=N/(EA)=200 microstrain; at E=12 GPa it is 100 microstrain, excluding creep and shrinkage.

calculations.label: exponential convergence mm
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm，t以day計，u(5)=12.64 mm、u(10)=17.29 mm；極限20 mm只是模型參數，非現場允收限值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm with t in days. Values are u(5)=12.64 mm and u(10)=17.29 mm; the 20 mm asymptote is a model parameter, not a field acceptance limit.

calculations.label: water resultant kN
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設均勻表壓p=150 kPa作用於局部平面A=2 m²，合力F=pA=300 kN；這是假設局部均壓，非整個彎曲襯砌的總合力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform gauge pressure p=150 kPa on local plane area A=2 m². Resultant F=pA=300 kN applies to this idealized local patch, not the entire curved lining.

calculations.label: nonunique displacement mm
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u=F/k=10 mm，可由F=500 kN、k=50 kN/mm，也可由F=1000 kN、k=100 kN/mm得到；一個位移觀測無法區分兩組。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. An observed u=F/k=10 mm can arise from F=500 kN with k=50 kN/mm or F=1000 kN with k=100 kN/mm. One displacement observation cannot distinguish the two pairs.

calculations.label: defect fraction percent
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設檢查面積200 m²、已確認需處置區8 m²，面積比8/200=4%；若其中2 m²位於關鍵接縫，不能被其餘192 m²良好區平均掉。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume inspected area 200 m² and confirmed treatment area 8 m²: the fraction is 8/200=4%. If 2 m² lies at critical joints, the 192 m² of satisfactory area cannot average that issue away.

calculations.label: support reaction kN
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設垂直合力W=900 kN且對稱，左右反力各450 kN；若假設分配為60%與40%，則為540及360 kN，總和仍為900 kN。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume vertical resultant W=900 kN. Symmetry gives 450 kN at each side. A hypothetical 60/40 split instead gives 540 and 360 kN, still summing to 900 kN.

calculations.label: exposure days
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設兩作業點穩定相距12 m、同步平均推進2 m/day，一斷面等待時間12/2=6 days；加入3天停頓則為9 days，非允許等待期。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume two work points remain 12 m apart while advancing at 2 m/day. A section waits 12/2=6 days; a three-day shutdown makes nine days. Neither is an allowable waiting period.

calculations.label: bearing kPa
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設反力R=600 kN、有效接觸A=1.2 m²，平均q=500 kPa；若接觸降為0.8 m²，q=750 kPa，未檢查地層承載或沉陷。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume reaction R=600 kN and effective contact A=1.2 m². Mean bearing q=500 kPa; with A=0.8 m² it becomes 750 kPa, without checking ground capacity or settlement.

calculations.label: core volume m3 and fraction percent
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設整段面積60 m²、長4 m，總體積240 m³；保留核心面積12 m²同長，體積48 m³，占20%，未代表提供20%抗力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume total area 60 m² over 4 m, giving 240 m³. A retained core of 12 m² over the same length occupies 48 m³ or 20%, which does not mean it supplies 20% resistance.

calculations.label: rotation rad and degrees
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設左右拱腳相距6 m、沉陷差4 mm=0.004 m，剛體小轉角θ≈0.004/6=0.000667 rad=0.0382°，並非容許變形值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume feet are 6 m apart with differential settlement 4 mm=0.004 m. Rigid-body small rotation θ≈0.004/6=0.000667 rad=0.0382°, not an allowable deformation.

calculations.label: mass t and loose m3
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設下半面積25 m²、進尺1.5 m、原位密度2400 kg/m³，質量25×1.5×2400=90000 kg=90 t；假設鬆方係數1.4時體積為52.5 m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume lower area 25 m², advance 1.5 m and in-situ density 2400 kg/m³. Mass is 90000 kg=90 t. With assumed bulking factor 1.4, loose volume is 52.5 m³.

calculations.label: catch-up days and equal-speed relative m/day
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設初始落後20 m，上半前進2 m/day、仰拱完成3 m/day，縮短速度1 m/day，理想追平需20 days；若兩者皆2 m/day則距離不縮小。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an initial 20 m gap, upper advance 2 m/day and invert completion 3 m/day. The gap shrinks at 1 m/day, requiring 20 days ideally; equal 2 m/day speeds never close it.

calculations.label: mean std mm and unchanged common bias
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設四次獨立讀值各標準差1 mm，平均標準差1/√4=0.5 mm；若另有共用基準偏差2 mm，它仍為2 mm，不隨四次平均消失。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four independent readings each with standard deviation 1 mm. Their mean has 1/√4=0.5 mm standard deviation. A shared 2 mm reference bias remains 2 mm despite averaging.

calculations.label: Darcy m3/s and m3/h
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設k=0.0001 m/s、A=15 m²、Δh=8 m、L=12 m，Q=kAΔh/L=0.001 m³/s=3.6 m³/h；水頭差減半則Q減半。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume k=0.0001 m/s, A=15 m², Δh=8 m and L=12 m. Q=kAΔh/L=0.001 m³/s=3.6 m³/h; halving head difference halves this ideal flow.

calculations.label: clearance m
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設實測高度5.20 m、所需高度5.05 m、保守量測扣減0.03 m，剩餘餘量5.20-5.05-0.03=0.12 m；未含未來變形預留。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume measured height 5.20 m, required height 5.05 m and conservative measurement deduction 0.03 m. Remaining allowance is 0.12 m, before reserving future movement.

calculations.label: simple beam moment kN m
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設q=30 kN/m、L=8 m，M=qL²/8=240 kN·m；將理想跨度減為4 m則M=60 kN·m，僅適用相同均布與簡支邊界。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume q=30 kN/m and L=8 m. M=qL²/8=240 kN·m; an ideal 4 m span gives 60 kN·m, under the same uniform loading and simple-support boundaries only.

calculations.label: resultant and eccentricity m
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設截面寬12 m，向下力600 kN位於x=2 m、400 kN位於x=10 m，合力位置x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m，偏中心0.8 m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a 12 m section with downward forces 600 kN at x=2 m and 400 kN at x=10 m. Resultant x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m, 0.8 m from center.

calculations.label: Euler ideal force kN
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設兩端鉸接、EI=20000 kN·m²、有效H=6 m，Pcr=π²EI/H²=5483 kN；H增至9 m則2437 kN，未含初始缺陷或非彈性。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume pinned ends, EI=20000 kN·m² and effective H=6 m. Pcr=π²EI/H²=5483 kN; at H=9 m it is 2437 kN, excluding imperfections and inelastic behavior.

calculations.label: moment kN m and edge MPa
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設單位寬N=500 kN、e=0.10 m、t=0.30 m，M=50 kN·m；σ=N/t±6M/t²=1.667±3.333 MPa，兩緣5與-1.667 MPa。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a 1 m strip assume N=500 kN, eccentricity e=0.10 m and thickness t=0.30 m. M=50 kN·m; σ=N/t±6M/t²=1.667±3.333 MPa, giving 5 and -1.667 MPa at the edges.

calculations.label: spring displacement mm and force kN
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總F=1000 kN、並聯k1=20及k2=30 kN/mm，位移20 mm、分力400與600 kN；移除k1後位移1000/30=33.33 mm。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume total F=1000 kN and parallel stiffnesses k1=20 and k2=30 kN/mm. Displacement is 20 mm and forces are 400 and 600 kN. Removing k1 gives 1000/30=33.33 mm.

calculations.label: ideal resistance and shortfall kN
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設四個獨立同向支承各有200 kN已給定能力，總800 kN；少一個後僅600 kN，對假設需求700 kN差100 kN，未含分項與群體效應。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four independent supports with supplied same-direction resistance 200 kN each, totaling 800 kN. With one absent, 600 kN remains against assumed demand 700 kN, leaving a 100 kN gap before factors or group effects.

calculations.label: sum correlated and independent std mm
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設相加量兩項標準差2與3 mm、相關係數ρ=0.5，σ=√(2²+3²+2×0.5×2×3)=4.36 mm；若獨立則3.61 mm。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a sum, assume standard deviations 2 and 3 mm and correlation ρ=0.5. σ=√(2²+3²+2×0.5×2×3)=4.36 mm; independence would give 3.61 mm.

calculations.label: validation RMSE mm
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設三個保留觀測為4、7、10 mm，預測為5、7、8 mm，誤差為1、0、-2 mm，RMSE=√[(1²+0²+2²)/3]=1.29 mm。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume withheld observations 4, 7 and 10 mm with predictions 5, 7 and 8 mm. Errors are 1, 0 and -2 mm; RMSE=√[(1²+0²+2²)/3]=1.29 mm.

calculations.label: water pressure kPa and local force kN
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設淡水水頭18 m，p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa；在假設平面面積1.5 m²上F=264.87 kN，未代表整個曲面襯砌的合力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume freshwater head 18 m: p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa. On an ideal plane area 1.5 m², F=264.87 kN; this is not the resultant over the whole curved lining.

calculations.label: register percent and unresolved
calculations.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設交接列80項界面，已核准76項，完成率76/80=95%；剩餘4項若含荷載轉移驗證，即使比例只有5%也不能自動結案。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 80 interface items with 76 approved: completion is 76/80=95%. If the remaining four include load-transfer verification, their 5% share does not justify automatic closure.
